brief:
Israel permitted roughly 50 percent of the agreed volume of humanitarian and commercial goods into Gaza each month since March, according to data cited by Middle East Eye. The figure represents a significant shortfall from commitments made under the Gaza ceasefire deal.

The discrepancy suggests a widening gap between pledged and actual aid deliveries to the territory, where the humanitarian situation remains dire following months of conflict.

title: Israel allows half promised aid trucks into Gaza since March
